say:1:1441126001:1.text: Good question! Honestly, I think it's uncertain.
say:1:1441126001:1.source_cn: 有趣，萨洛克兰的未来，我眼前也是一片迷雾呢。

say:2:1441126002:1.text: With the Queen's passing, the people of Sal'thorin found out about the dragon and witnessed its departure all at once...
say:2:1441126002:1.source_cn: 女王崩逝，萨洛克兰的民众得知了龙的存在，并在同一时刻目...

say:3:1441126003:1.text: Right now, they have no idea what all these events mean. They just know that everything is about to change.
say:3:1441126003:1.source_cn: 现在他们不知道这意味着什么，只知道一切都会发生变化。

say:4:1441126004:1.text: Once they decide how they view these changes, there will be two possible outcomes.
say:4:1441126004:1.source_cn: 当他们意识到变化是好的或坏的时，就只剩两种可能。

say:5:1441126005:1.text: Either Indris will be slain, or he will become a soulless symbol of justice, revered by the people.
say:5:1441126005:1.source_cn: 因度厄或被撕碎，或被当成傀儡高高架起宣扬正义。

say:6:1441126006:1.text: Either way, I don't think Indris is ready to face it. The long-suppressed conflicts among the commoners, nobles, priests, and servants are bound to erupt like lava.
say:6:1441126006:1.source_cn: 不管哪一种，他都没做好心理准备吧。平民，贵族，祭司，仆...

say:7:1441126007:1.text: Once a crack forms in the mountain that conceals it, the lava will burst out like a blazing torch, turning all of Sal'thorin into a sea of flames.
say:7:1441126007:1.source_cn: 遮掩它的山体一旦生隙，岩浆就会喷发如炬，将萨洛克兰蔓延...

choice_prompt:8:1441126007.text: Once a crack forms in the mountain that conceals it, the lava will burst out like a blazing torch, turning all of Sal'thorin into a sea of flames.
choice_prompt:8:1441126007.source_cn: 遮掩它的山体一旦生隙，岩浆就会喷发如炬，将萨洛克兰蔓延成一片火海。

say:10:1441126008:1.text: Instead of all the drama here, I'm more curious about what Indris will discover above ground.
say:10:1441126008:1.source_cn: 比起这些，我更期待因度厄在地表看到的事物。

say:11:1441126009:1.text: The Queen's grace is gone, but the curse still lingers in Sal'thorin.
say:11:1441126009:1.source_cn: 萨洛克兰已经没有退路，恩典已经消弭，但诅咒尚存。

say:12:1441126010:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, since you come from the surface, tell me—does the world above hold our future?
say:12:1441126010:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, since you come from the surface, tell me—does the world above hold our future?
say:12:1441126010:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, since you come from the surface, tell me—does the world above hold our future?

choice_prompt:13:1441126010.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, since you come from the surface, tell me—does the world above hold our future?
choice_prompt:13:1441126010.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，你从地表来，告诉我，地表的世界是我们的未来吗？
choice_prompt:13:1441126010.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, since you come from the surface, tell me—does the world above hold our future?
choice_prompt:13:1441126010.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, since you come from the surface, tell me—does the world above hold our future?

say:14:1441126011:1.text: Is that so... Well then, I suppose I'll wait for Indris to tell me his answer.
say:14:1441126011:1.source_cn: 是这样吗……我等着因度厄带来他的答案。

choice:9:0:1.text: So no one can manipulate him?
choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 是让他不被任何一方利用？
choice:9:0:1.male: So no one can manipulate him?
choice:9:0:1.female: So no one can manipulate him?

choice:9:1:2.text: So no one can plot against him?
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 是为了让别有用心之人失去目标？
choice:9:1:2.male: So no one can plot against him?
choice:9:1:2.female: So no one can plot against him?

choice:8:0:1.text: So, you sent Indris to the surface...
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 所以你让因度厄去地表的目的……
choice:8:0:1.male: So, you sent Indris to the surface...
choice:8:0:1.female: So, you sent Indris to the surface...
